purpose: Phase-3 biological TRANSPORT registry for the Profile-B simulator. Defines ONLY the passive movement of the topical NLC carrier from the formulation into the skin (topical -> skin surface -> stratum corneum -> viable epidermis -> dermis -> target region). It is the evidence backbone for the biological state machine, transport mechanisms, barriers, per-species support, and the particle spec. The code hardcodes NO biology - every state, transition, mechanism, barrier and species rule is data here, each with provenance + confidence. NO drug release, cell entry, endocytosis, payload, PK or PD is defined (later phases).
authoritative_source: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN). Values not restated there are treated as NOT REPORTED and are never invented.

evidence_levels.note: Phase 3.1: Evidence Level classifies HOW WELL a species' topical transport is supported. It is layered on top of (not a replacement for) the per-transition confidence vocabulary. EXPERIMENTAL ALWAYS has priority over PREDICTIVE; predictions are NEVER presented as experimental observations and NEVER replace experimental data.

EXPERIMENTAL.meaning: Species-specific experimental topical-permeation data exists for THIS formulation.

PREDICTIVE.meaning: No species-specific experimental permeation data for this formulation. Animation is based on that species' OWN skin anatomy plus established passive-transport principles (Brownian, Fickian, SC rate-limiting). Qualitative only; NOT experimentally validated; NO quantitative timing / concentration / diffusion-coefficient / penetration-depth claims. Rat parameters are NOT used.

UNAVAILABLE.meaning: Cannot be animated (no anatomy profile for the species, or explicitly unsupported).

integrity.predictive_mode: Human and Mouse run in PREDICTIVE mode: they animate using their OWN anatomy profiles (Phase 2.6) + general passive-transport principles, clearly labelled 'Predictive', and are NEVER presented as experimental observations. Rat remains the EXPERIMENTAL reference; its data is never replaced by predictions and its parameters are never copied into human/mouse. The species difference comes from each species' own anatomy depth bands, not from fabricated per-species mobility.
integrity.experimental_priority: EXPERIMENTAL > PREDICTIVE. A species' evidence level is fixed by its own record; the active species selects its own level, so experimental and predictive modes never mix.
integrity.topical_no_circulation: Profile-B (B1) is TOPICAL: there is NO systemic circulation, lymphatic or blood stage. The 'target region' is the skin (dermis), not a distant organ. Consistent with the frozen biological-visualization blueprint (B1 topical = no circulation stage).
integrity.intact_np_vs_drug: Chen 2012 measured tripterine (the DRUG) permeation across full-thickness rat skin and its depth distribution (skin sections 0-30 / 30-60 / 60-90 um). Whether the INTACT NLC carrier - as opposed to released drug - reaches the deep dermis is NOT REPORTED and is mechanistically uncertain (lipid nanocarriers frequently act within the stratum corneum). This engine depicts CARRIER transport SCHEMATICALLY and evidence-tagged; it does NOT assert intact-nanoparticle dermal arrival as measured fact.
integrity.schematic_timing: Movement is anchored to the reported experimental time window (skin-permeation time series 1-12 h) and to the biologically-supported barrier ORDERING (stratum corneum rate-limiting). Per-layer diffusion coefficients, flux, permeability and lag NUMBERS are NOT restated in the frozen package (NOT REPORTED) and are NOT invented here. Absolute timing is therefore SCHEMATIC.
integrity.no_active_transport: Topical permeation of a passive lipid nanocarrier is modelled as PASSIVE only (thermal + concentration-driven). Active transport / carrier-mediated uptake is NOT applicable and is explicitly excluded.

particle.label: Surface-charged tripterine-loaded nanostructured lipid carrier
particle.charge_note: Chen reports permeation/uptake ORDER varies with surface charge (cellular uptake cationic > neutral > anionic); exact per-charge skin-permeation NUMBERS are NOT restated in the frozen package, so charge is a LABEL only here (not a per-charge speed).

appearance.note: muted flat dot resembling scientific molecular animation; no glow / gaming effects / explosions

states.name: Topical Formulation
states.description: The applied NLC dispersion sitting on the skin surface (donor compartment).

evidence.notes: Topical NLC applied to skin (Franz-cell donor).

states.name: Skin Surface
states.description: The air/skin interface where the carrier first contacts the outermost skin.

states.name: Stratum Corneum
states.description: The outermost keratinised barrier - the principal rate-limiting layer for topical permeation.

evidence.notes: SC is the rate-limiting barrier (consensus: StatPearls NBK537325; OpenStax A&P). Chen frames the NLC as ENHANCING skin permeation across this barrier.

states.name: Viable Epidermis
states.description: The living epidermal layers below the SC; mobility increases once the SC is crossed.

evidence.notes: Chen sampled skin to 0-90 um depth, spanning SC + viable tissue.

states.name: Dermis
states.description: The connective-tissue layer; least resistant to a small carrier/drug.

evidence.notes: Depth sections reach into the dermis in thin rat skin; per-layer diffusion NOT REPORTED.

states.name: Target Region (skin)
states.description: The topical target tissue (skin/dermis). Topical B1 has NO systemic target.

evidence.notes: Arrival in the target skin tissue. Intact-NP vs released-drug arrival is NOT REPORTED (see integrity.intact_np_vs_drug).
Topical application: carrier deposits onto the skin surface.
Partition/entry from the surface into the SC lipids down the concentration gradient.
The rate-limiting step: crossing the SC. Slowed by the SC barrier; the NLC is reported to ENHANCE this permeation (Chen).
Continued inward diffusion once past the SC; mobility higher than in the SC.
Arrival in the target skin tissue over the reported 1-12 h window. Intact-NP arrival NOT REPORTED (schematic).

contact_deposition.name: Contact / deposition
contact_deposition.rationale: Topical dosing deposits the carrier onto the skin surface (donor compartment).

brownian_motion.name: Brownian (thermal) motion
brownian_motion.rationale: ~85-90 nm carriers undergo thermal random-walk diffusion. A universal physical principle applied to the reported carrier size; magnitude is schematic.

concentration_gradient.name: Concentration-driven (Fickian) movement
concentration_gradient.rationale: Net inward movement down the concentration gradient from the high-concentration formulation into the skin; supported by the time-increasing skin-permeation series (1-12 h).

barrier_slowing_sc.name: Stratum-corneum barrier slowing
barrier_slowing_sc.rationale: The SC is the principal permeation barrier (consensus); it reduces carrier mobility, making SC crossing the rate-limiting step.

post_sc_mobility_increase.name: Post-SC mobility increase
post_sc_mobility_increase.rationale: Below the SC, the viable epidermis and (hydrated) dermis resist a small carrier less than the SC does, so mobility increases with depth.

active_transport.name: Active / carrier-mediated transport
active_transport.rationale: Passive topical permeation of a lipid nanocarrier: active transport is NOT applicable and is explicitly excluded (never animated).

barriers.note: relative_mobility is a SCHEMATIC ORDINAL modifier (0 = impermeable, 1 = free) applied to particle movement in each layer. Only the ORDERING is evidence-based (SC << viable epidermis < dermis); the magnitudes are schematic - per-layer diffusion coefficients are NOT REPORTED and are NOT measured values. Modifiers are NOT arbitrary: each has a biological rationale + provenance. IMPORTANT (Phase 3.1): the barrier ORDERING is GENERAL, species-INDEPENDENT mammalian skin biology (consensus), NOT a rat-derived parameter - it applies equally to human, mouse and rat. Per-species transport differences arise from each species' OWN anatomy depth bands (Phase 2.6), never from copying values between species.

stratum_corneum.rationale: The SC is the dominant barrier to topical permeation (consensus: StatPearls NBK537325; OpenStax A&P). Lowest mobility -> SC crossing is the slow, rate-limiting step, consistent with Chen needing an enhancing carrier.

viable_epidermis.rationale: Once past the SC, the viable epidermis offers intermediate resistance - more mobile than the SC, less than the open dermis.

dermis.rationale: The hydrated, loosely-organised dermis resists a small carrier/drug the least; highest relative mobility.

skin_surface.rationale: The surface interface is not a diffusion barrier.

species_transport.note: Species-driven + evidence-gated with an EVIDENCE LEVEL. rat = EXPERIMENTAL (published permeation). human/mouse = PREDICTIVE (Phase 3.1): they ANIMATE using their OWN anatomy + general passive-transport principles, clearly labelled, NOT experimentally validated, and with NO rat parameters copied and NO permeation citation claimed. A species with no anatomy profile would be UNAVAILABLE (blocked). Experimental data is never replaced by predictions.

rat.tissue: full-thickness abdominal skin of young male Sprague-Dawley rats; skin sections 0-30 / 30-60 / 60-90 um (Franz cell, PBS pH 7.4)
rat.message: Evidence Level: Experimental. Based on published topical permeation experiments for this formulation (Chen 2012, ex-vivo full-thickness rat skin).
rat.notes: The transport PROCESS is directly studied (drug permeation across skin over 1-12 h). Per-layer diffusion coefficients / flux / lag are NOT restated in the frozen package (schematic timing).

human.context: PREDICTIVE_HUMAN_SKIN (Chen used HaCaT for in-vitro UPTAKE only, NOT permeation)
human.principle_basis: Established human skin barrier biology (stratum corneum rate-limiting -> viable epidermis -> dermis) + general passive nanoparticle transport (Brownian + Fickian diffusion, barrier resistance), applied to the HUMAN anatomy profile's own depth bands. No rat parameters used.
principle_refs: general passive-diffusion / Brownian / Fickian transport principles
human.message: Evidence Level: Predictive. This visualization is based on established human skin anatomy and general nanoparticle transport principles. Quantitative transport of this specific formulation has not yet been experimentally validated in human skin.
human.notes: PREDICTIVE only. No experimental human skin-permeation data for this formulation; nothing is presented as an experimental observation and no rat data is borrowed.

mouse.context: PREDICTIVE_MOUSE_SKIN (C57BL/6 used for melanoma pharmacodynamics, NOT permeation)
mouse.principle_basis: Established mouse skin barrier biology (stratum corneum rate-limiting -> viable epidermis -> dermis; rodent skin thin, panniculus carnosus) + general passive nanoparticle transport (Brownian + Fickian diffusion, barrier resistance), applied to the MOUSE anatomy profile's own depth bands. No rat parameters used.
